applies_why: The rule governs whether cited verses count as unanswered witnesses, and the judge text addresses whether the Isaiah 7:14 wording was answered rather than counting it as unanswered.
quote: Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge treats the Isaiah 7:14 wording as answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness, which obeys K-G4.
